# Shubham Raj - Full Stack Developer

Shubham Raj is a Full Stack Developer specializing in Python, Django, and React.js. He builds scalable, elegant web experiences.

## Technical Skills
- **Languages:** Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, SQL
- **Frontend:** React.js, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap
- **Backend & Database:** Django REST Framework, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- **Tools & Others:** Git/GitHub, Vercel, Postman, WebSockets

## Projects
- **UrbanShift:** A comprehensive relocation and property platform integrating property buying/renting with Packers & Movers booking services. Built with React.js, Django REST, PostgreSQL, and WebSockets.
- **Techvolution:** A high-conversion landing page for a tech conference, built with HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript.
- **Registration Portal:** A dynamic student registration form with robust client-side validation logic using regex.
